appearances.text: I’ll help you narrow it down to something that suits your vehicle instead of chasing whichever product has the biggest headline number.
Construction, weave and GSM.
GSM stands for grams per square metre and tells you the weight of the fabric.
I’d check GSM alongside the rest of the specification instead of using one impressive number to call a towel better, safer or faster.
GSM in context
Where the Street Kingz 1200 GSM towel fits
This is our own 1200gsm drying towel.
It has a 1200 GSM dual-sided microfibre construction, measures 90 × 60 cm, uses soft microfibre edging and is listed as suitable for cars and larger vehicles.
Dimensions and edging.
Dimensions tell you how much area the towel can cover and how easy it should be to place and control.
A larger towel may be handy across broad panels, but bigger isn’t automatically better.
Dimensions
Choose a format you can still control comfortably partway through the job.
A larger vehicle with broad panels may make a larger towel more convenient, while a smaller car or tighter bodywork may suit something easier to position.

Edging

The Street Kingz towel covered next is specifically described as becoming heavier when saturated, so it’s a trade-off you should expect rather than discover halfway through the job.
My view is that it makes the most sense if you actively want a large, dense towel and you’re comfortable with the extra weight once it’s saturated.
Wring it only when it becomes saturated.
Use and care instructions.
How to wash, dry and care for the towel
Do not use fabric softener.
Do not use bleach.
Air dry rather than tumble dry.
For the Street Kingz towel, use a cold, gentle wash with suitable detergent, then let it air dry before putting it away clean and dry.
Construction, weave and GSM.
Construction is how the towel is made, while weave is how its fibres are arranged.
Microfibre towels come in different constructions and weaves, including waffle-style options, but the label alone won’t tell you which towel is better.

A purpose-made microfibre drying towel is a sensible option, but I can’t honestly say every microfibre towel is better than every waffle-weave towel, chamois or other method.
